title: 波士顿动力创始人：机器人未来最兴奋的是什么？生产力机会巨大
speaker: Marc Raibert

segments.en: So let's talk about the most positive thing.
segments.zh: 让我们谈谈最积极的事情。

segments.en: I mean, what are you most excited about when it comes to robotics?
segments.zh: 在机器人领域，你最兴奋的是什么？

segments.en: I mean, anything that is possibly the unimaginable that could happen?
segments.zh: 有没有可能发生难以想象的事情？

segments.en: I'll try and give two kinds of answers.
So I'm a researcher developer and it's not all about making money for me, it's about making the technical advances and creating new things.
segments.zh: 我是研究员和开发者，对我来说不全是赚钱，而是取得技术进步和创造新事物。

segments.en: And you know, there's no necessarily end point in sight.
segments.zh: 而且不一定看得到终点。

segments.en: You know, they made computers that were big and operated at one speed and then they got smaller and faster.
segments.zh: 他们造出又大又单一速度运行的计算机，然后它们变得更小更快。

segments.en: Now that you can carry them around, there's no limit to where the technology goes.
segments.zh: 现在你可以随身携带，技术发展没有极限。

segments.en: And robots are like that, too.
You know, right now a lot of people are focused on trying to make things with two arms, two legs and a head, but you know, maybe we'll have some weird new thing that we're going to.
segments.zh: 现在很多人专注于制造有两条手臂、两条腿和一个头的东西，但也许我们会有些奇怪的新东西。

segments.en: So that's the researcher side of me.
segments.zh: 这是我作为研究员的一面。

segments.en: I do think that there's limitations to productivity for everybody.
segments.zh: 我确实认为每个人的生产力都有限制。

segments.en: I think the, as I said before, there's aging population, there's declining populations, there's people who don't really want to work in the trades as much as they did.
segments.zh: 正如我之前所说，人口老龄化，人口减少，人们不像以前那么愿意从事某些行业。

segments.en: Now don't get me wrong, robots aren't up to doing what a plumber or electrician does yet, but they will be, I think.
segments.zh: 别误会，机器人还做不到水管工或电工的工作，但我认为它们将来可以。

segments.en: So there's an opportunity to have high productivity without necessarily having people available to do all those things.
segments.zh: 所以有机会在不一定有足够人力做所有这些事的情况下实现高生产力。
